verificationSummary: Editor commit 2be3145210eac74ecc6b82d547f6471456b36114 adds an Editor-owned node placement readiness matrix in src/editor/commands/nodePlacementReadiness.ts and focused tests in src/tests/nodePlacementReadiness.test.ts. The implementation mirrors Core allowed child types into CoreEditorNodeCapabilities, clones them through the Editor read model, and exposes them through the command capability mirror. The readiness matrix records visible surface node ids, represented internal Core runtime node ids, before and after sibling add slots resolved through visible operation surfaces, inside placement for real Core runtime containers that accept flow children, append placements by container id, and explicit blocked reasons for columns, table, table-row, and leaf targets. All ready placement plans keep activationStatus blocked with the reason Add-node transport is not enabled for Editor runtime yet. Accepted RED evidence included npm test -- src/tests/nodePlacementReadiness.test.ts failing because ../editor/commands/nodePlacementReadiness did not exist, and a later focused failure where the matrix revision incorrectly used the Core runtime node count 15 instead of capability revision 3. GREEN passed npm test -- src/tests/nodePlacementReadiness.test.ts with 1 file and 3 tests. Related regression passed npm test -- src/tests/workingSetFactory.test.ts src/tests/nodePresentation.test.ts src/tests/commands.test.ts src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts src/tests/nodePlacementReadiness.test.ts with 5 files and 32 tests. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, 95 test files with 329 tests, and build. Guardrail search found no new node.insert, text-block.insert, columns.insert, table.row.insert, table.column.insert, or enabled outline-add state under src; existing input and textarea matches belong to PreviewTestInputView and existing text-block authoring boundary tests. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor node placement readiness matrix and capability mirroring. It does not enable add-node mutation transport, Backend insert requests, visible WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, active text input UI, field chip UI, durable draft persistence, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth. Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning; it was not remediated in this lane. The linked Editor worktree C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 remains intentionally retained on branch editor-node-placement-readiness-20260830 because node_modules contains junctions to Core and previous recursive cleanup exposed dependency-link side effects.
